user.title: Connect to BorgBackup Add-on
user.description: Enter the connection details for the BorgBackup add-on. Install and start the add-on first, then enter its connection details here.

data_description.host: Hostname of the BorgBackup add-on. For the local add-on use "local-borgbackup".
data_description.port: Port the BorgBackup add-on API listens on (default: 8774).
data_description.api_key: API key generated by the BorgBackup add-on. Shown in the add-on logs on first start.

hassio_confirm.title: BorgBackup Add-on Detected
hassio_confirm.description: The BorgBackup add-on has been detected at {host}:{port}. Click Confirm to connect it as a backup destination.

reauth_confirm.title: Update BorgBackup API Key
reauth_confirm.description: The API key for the BorgBackup add-on at {host} was rejected. Enter the current API key.

data_description.api_key: The current API key from the BorgBackup add-on.

reconfigure.title: Edit BorgBackup Connection
reconfigure.description: Update the connection details for the BorgBackup add-on. The connection will be verified before saving.

data_description.port: Port the BorgBackup add-on API listens on.
data_description.api_key: API key for the BorgBackup add-on.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the BorgBackup add-on. Make sure the add-on is installed and running.
error.invalid_api_key: The API key was rejected by the BorgBackup add-on.
error.addon_error: The BorgBackup add-on returned an unexpected error. Check the add-on logs.

abort.already_configured: The BorgBackup add-on is already configured.
abort.discovery_missing_api_key: The add-on's discovery message did not include an API key. Update the add-on and restart it, or set up the connection manually.

cannot_connect.message: BorgBackup cannot connect to the add-on.

invalid_api_key.message: The API key for the BorgBackup add-on was rejected.

addon_error.message: The BorgBackup add-on returned an unexpected error.
